title: 100% Organic Cotton Bascik Logo on Front Only (Unisex)
description:
This vintage-style t-shirt has that soft, worn-in look people love from day one. The garment-dyed finish creates subtle color variations, making every piece feel unique and relaxed. It’s an easy everyday tee that works just as well styled up or worn casually.

• 100% organic ring-spun cotton

• Fabric weight: 5.6 oz./yd.² (190 g/m²)

• Relaxed fit with a comfortable drape

• Garment-dyed finish with a washed, vintage look

• Side-seamed construction for a clean shape

• Set-in sleeves

• Ribbed collar for a classic finish

title: Organic Cotton Bascik Logo Sweatshirt (Unisex)
description:
A cozy, mid-weight sweatshirt with the Bascik logo on the front. The relaxed fit makes it an easy layer for those not-too-hot, not-too-cold days, with a subtle half-moon detail on the back.

• US fulfillment: 80% organic combed ring-spun cotton, 20% recycled polyester

• European fulfillment: 85% organic combed ring-spun cotton, 15% recycled polyester

• Fabric weight: 8.3 oz./yd.² (280 g/m²)

• Relaxed fit with set-in sleeves

• Ribbed collar, cuffs, and hem

• Twin-needle top stitching and herringbone back neck tape

• Certified organic cotton and recycled content (GOTS, OCS, and GRS)

• Blank product sourced from Bangladesh

Sizing: US sizes are shown. European customers should order one size down. Made on demand.
